caribbean.headline: Heavy Showers and Choppy Seas Near Roatan
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing an onshore ENE swell with 8 s periods, sustained winds near 20 kt and seas to 5.4 ft, while showers and thunderstorms are producing 100% rain probability. I expect Small Craft Advisory criteria to be met for exposed vessels around Roatan and advise operators in Barbados (max winds 14 kt) to prepare for gusty, choppy conditions and localized heavy rain.

mediterranean.headline: Marseille Braces for Southwest Winds and Showers
mediterranean.paragraph: Marseille is experiencing southwesterly winds to 18 kt with wave heights near 3.3 ft and a dominant SW swell at a 5 s period, with 62% rain probability. I expect conditions to remain below Small Craft Advisory thresholds, while Palma de Mallorca reports winds near 16 kt and generally lower seas.
